name: 33013 · Hialeah, FL
findings: ZIP 33013 (Hialeah) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33013 (Hialeah) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
